design: Discovery-only rank1/2/3 SVD bases of concatenated eight-layer context-shift residuals around frozen H641 means. Four original discovery items per family/template pair. Fresh coefficients are oracle Euclidean projections of true donor context residual, shared across probes and layers; evaluate actual composed responses with both endpoint choices.
limitations: Basis fitted on discovery only, coefficients use fresh donor contexts. Euclidean projection is not functionally optimal; this is not an output-space upper bound or predictor. No rank selection.
